scripts.db:import: node scripts/import-paper.mjs content/sample-paper.json > .wrangler/import.sql && wrangler d1 execute cbt --local --file .wrangler/import.sql
scripts.import:remote: node scripts/import-all.mjs > .wrangler/import-all.sql && wrangler d1 execute cbt --remote --file .wrangler/import-all.sql
scripts.deploy:ci: wrangler d1 migrations apply cbt --remote && npm run import:remote && wrangler deploy
